source: The Check Studio project (backlog 7.1), sections 4 and 5.4: the faults' codes, severities and English texts, paraphrasing the GS1 General Specifications release 26.0 (January 2026), whose section numbers they cite.

groups.A: The carrier: is it a GS1 symbol at all?
groups.F: The symbol against the reading context
groups.H: What a picture can and cannot say

texts.what: Data Matrix used instead of GS1 DataMatrix
texts.where: The identifier chip and position 0, where FNC1 should be
texts.why: GS1 DataMatrix is a Data Matrix with FNC1 first, which a reader reports as ]d2 (5.6.3.3). Plain Data Matrix carries only a GS1 Digital Link URI (5.9; table 5-2 in 5.1.3). A scanner following 7.8 will not treat this as GS1 data.
texts.fix: Set the encoder to GS1 mode ("GS1 DataMatrix", "FNC1 in first position"), not a typed character. Offer: make this symbol correctly (opens the generator with the data).

faults.detectedBy: Identifier ]d1 (not ]d2); the data is not a URI, and parses as element strings once FNC1 is assumed

texts.what: QR Code without FNC1 carrying element strings
texts.why: GS1 QR Code is reported as ]Q3 (5.7, table 5-2); plain QR Code carries only a GS1 Digital Link URI (5.10).
texts.fix: GS1 QR Code mode (FNC1 in first position), or re-make as a Digital Link URI.

faults.detectedBy: Identifier ]Q1 (or ]Q0), data not a URI, parses as element strings

texts.what: Code 128 instead of GS1-128
texts.why: FNC1 after the start character is what distinguishes GS1-128 (7.8.5, 5.4.7.4); it is the first feature to check (5.12.5.10.4).
texts.fix: GS1-128 mode in the software or printer command.

faults.detectedBy: Identifier ]C0, data parses as element strings

texts.what: The flag typed as text
texts.why: The symbology identifier is produced by the reader, never encoded (5.1.3); FNC1 is a function character, not letters.
texts.fix: Remove the text; switch GS1 mode on.

faults.detectedBy: Data begins with the characters FNC1, ]d2, ]C1, ]Q3, <F1>, ~1, \F or byte 232

texts.what: A separator in place of the leading FNC1
texts.why: Only FNC1 in the first position flags GS1 data (5.6.3.3).
texts.fix: As A1.

faults.detectedBy: ]d1 or ]Q1 and first byte is 29 (<GS>)

texts.what: A GS1 Digital Link URI inside a GS1 DataMatrix or GS1 QR Code
texts.why: FNC1 mode announces element strings (table 5-2); a URI belongs in the plain symbol.
texts.fix: Encode the URI in a plain QR Code or Data Matrix, or encode the element strings.

faults.detectedBy: ]d2 or ]Q3 and the data starts with http

texts.what: ITF that is not ITF-14, or check digit not verified by the reader
texts.why: ITF is not exclusive to GS1: check for 14 digits (7.2.6). With ]I0 the check digit must be verified separately (7.2.7); the studio does it.
texts.fix: Encode 14 digits; pad a GTIN-13 with a leading zero.

faults.detectedBy: ]I0/]I1 with a length other than 14; or ]I0

texts.what: Not a GS1 carrier or not GS1 data
texts.why: Outside the GS1 system. Not a fault of the symbol: it is counted as "non-GS1" in surveys.
texts.fix: None; if GS1 data was intended, see the generator.

faults.detectedBy: Any other identifier or format (Code 39, PDF417, Aztec, HIBC +…), or data that no repair makes valid

texts.what: A symbol type the studio cannot read
texts.why: The decoder has no GS1 DotCode decoder and leaves out a Composite Component's 2D part (measured in docs/conformance.md, section 3.1).
texts.fix: Use a scanner in keyboard mode.

faults.detectedBy: The decoder finds a pattern but no data, or the user says so

texts.what: The AIs' parentheses are encoded
texts.why: Parentheses are for people; they are not encoded in the barcode (4.14; 1.4.2; "absence of encoded parentheses" in 5.12.5.10.4).
texts.fix: Give the software the data without parentheses, or use its GS1 input mode that strips them.

faults.detectedBy: Bytes ( and ) around digits at AI positions; valid once removed. Engine otherwise says No known AI is a prefix of…

texts.what: Spaces, line breaks or printed titles encoded (EXP, LOT, GTIN:)
texts.why: Only the AI and its data field are encoded (7.8.1); a space is not in the GS1 character set (7.11).
texts.fix: Encode the data, print the text separately.

faults.detectedBy: Bytes 32, 10, 13 or letters between element strings; valid once removed

faults.severityNote: Error when the engine rejects; Warning when only the heuristic fires

texts.what: Separator missing after a variable-length AI
texts.why: Every element string not in table 7-6 must be followed by a separator when another follows (7.8.3, 7.8.4).
texts.fix: Insert FNC1 (or <GS>) after the variable-length field; or move that field to the end.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: data is too long or a bad character; or the value ends in what parses as further AIs (heuristic), and inserting <GS> yields a valid message

texts.what: Separator after a predefined-length AI
texts.why: SHOULD NOT be used (7.8.3): wastes space; some receiving systems mis-split.
texts.fix: Remove it.

faults.detectedBy: <GS> after an AI of table 7-6

texts.what: Separator at the end of the data
texts.why: SHOULD NOT be used at the end of the last element string (7.8.3).
texts.fix: Remove it.

faults.detectedBy: Last byte is 29

texts.what: Wrong separator character
texts.why: The separator is FNC1 or <GS>; % only in GS1 QR Code (7.8.4).
texts.fix: Use the encoder's FNC1; do not type a stand-in.

faults.detectedBy: A visible stand-in between element strings: the text <GS>, {GS}, ^, ~, pipe, or % outside GS1 QR Code

texts.what: Unknown AI
texts.why: Not in the list of AIs (3.2). Often a symptom of B3 or of a wrong length before it.
texts.fix: Check the AI; check the field before it.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Unrecognised AI / No known AI is a prefix

texts.what: Wrong length for a fixed-length field
texts.why: E.g. a GTIN-13 under AI (01), which is 14 digits (3.3.2).
texts.fix: Pad a GTIN to 14 digits with leading zeros; correct the field.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: data has incorrect length, too short, too long

texts.what: Characters outside the allowed set
texts.why: Numeric fields take digits; alphanumeric fields take the GS1 subset of ISO/IEC 646 (7.11). Accented letters and most symbols are out.
texts.fix: Replace the character; never transliterate silently.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linter: non-digit character, non-CSET 82 / 39 / 64 character

texts.what: The same AI twice with different values
texts.why: An element string appears once per message (4.13).
texts.fix: Remove one.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Multiple instances of AI have different values

texts.what: Predefined-length AIs after variable-length ones
texts.why: Recommended sequencing (5.12.5.10.4); costs a separator and symbol space.
texts.fix: Put the key and fixed fields first.

faults.detectedBy: Own rule on the order

texts.what: More data than GS1-128 allows
texts.why: GS1-128 is limited to 48 data characters (5.4.7.2).
texts.fix: Split into two symbols or use a 2D symbol.

faults.detectedBy: gs1128DataCharacters() > 48 on a ]C1 reading

texts.what: Wrong check digit (GTIN, SSCC, GLN, GRAI, GSRN, GDTI…)
texts.where: The last digit of the key
texts.why: Standard check digit (7.9.1). 2D and GS1-128 readers do not verify it; the application must (7.2.7).
texts.fix: The studio shows the digit that would be right, and says that a wrong check digit usually means another digit was mistyped: confirm the number against the licence, do not just replace the last digit.

faults.detectedBy: checkDigit(); engine linter The numeric check digit is incorrect

texts.what: Wrong check character pair (GMN, AI 8013)
texts.fix: Recompute from the model number.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linter check-character pair

texts.what: GTIN-14 indicator 9 without a measure
texts.why: Indicator 9 means a variable measure trade item (2.1.10), which requires its quantity or measure (4.13.2).
texts.fix: Add the measure, or use the fixed-measure GTIN.

faults.detectedBy: First digit 9 and no AI (30), (31nn)–(36nn) or (8001); engine: Required AIs not satisfied

texts.what: GTIN-14 with indicator 1–8 in a retail point-of-sale context
texts.why: Indicators 1–8 identify trade item groupings (2.1.7.2), which are not what a till sells; EAN/UPC cannot carry them.
texts.fix: Check that the pack-level GTIN was not put on the consumer unit.

faults.detectedBy: First digit 1–8, context retail

texts.what: A GTIN-13, GTIN-12 or GTIN-8 not padded, or over-padded
texts.why: AI (01) is always 14 digits (3.3.2).
texts.fix: Pad with leading zeros.

faults.detectedBy: Length checks before the engine

texts.what: Restricted circulation or special prefix
texts.why: Valid only inside a company or territory (1.2.3.1; 2.1.11): will not work in open trade.
texts.fix: Use a licensed GTIN for open supply chains.

faults.detectedBy: GS1 Prefix 02, 04, 20–29 (restricted), 05, 98x, 99 (coupons), 978–979 (books), 977 (serials)

texts.what: An example number
texts.why: Reserved for demonstrations and examples (1.2.3.1).
texts.fix: Replace before printing for real.

faults.detectedBy: GS1 Prefix 952

faults.severityNote: Warning; Not assessed without the table
references: The GS1 Company Prefix licence, from the GS1 member organisation

texts.what: Company prefix not in the GCP table
texts.why: No licence found for that range.
texts.fix: Check the number with the GS1 member organisation.

faults.detectedBy: gcpLengthOf() when the user has loaded the table; engine linter The GS1 Company Prefix is invalid

faults.severityNote: Error alone; resolved in a group

texts.what: No key at all
texts.why: Attributes need their key (4.13.2). When several carriers are read as one item, a companion symbol may carry it: then not a fault.
texts.fix: Encode the key with its attributes in one symbol where possible (4.15.1 rule 9).

faults.detectedBy: Attributes only

texts.what: Impossible date
texts.why: Dates are YYMMDD (3.4); range checks are recommended to every system (7.2.7).
texts.fix: Correct the date; check the order was not DDMMYY.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linter illegal month, illegal day (31 April, 29 February of a common year, month 13)

texts.what: Day 00
texts.why: Allowed where the AI permits: it means the last day of the month (3.4.7 note). The simple view shows the date it stands for.
texts.fix: None, unless D3 applies.

faults.detectedBy: Value ends in 00

texts.what: Day 00 on a regulated healthcare item
texts.why: From 1 January 2025 the day SHALL NOT be two zeros for regulated healthcare products (3.4.7 note).
texts.fix: Encode the real last day.

faults.detectedBy: D2 in a pharmacy, pharmacy-gd or healthcare context

texts.what: Date order looks swapped
texts.why: 3.4: the order is fixed.
texts.fix: Re-order.

faults.detectedBy: Invalid as YYMMDD but valid as DDMMYY or MMDDYY

texts.what: Implausible dates
texts.why: Not a syntax rule: a plausibility test (7.2.7). The full year is computed by the century rule (7.12) and shown.
texts.fix: Check the source data.

faults.detectedBy: Expiry before production; expiry already past; production in the future; more than 30 years away

texts.what: Lot or serial with forbidden characters, or too long
texts.why: AI (10) and (21): up to 20 characters of the GS1 set (3.4.1; 7.11).
texts.fix: Replace; agree the format with whoever assigns it.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linter; length > 20

texts.what: Lot or serial likely to be mis-keyed
texts.why: Valid. A risk in manual entry and in URIs (/ must be percent-encoded).
texts.fix: Prefer letters and digits.

faults.detectedBy: Leading or trailing characters such as -, /, .; mixed O/0, I/1

texts.what: Measure of zero or implausible
texts.why: Implied decimal position from the AI's fourth digit (7.8.7); the decoded value is shown with its unit.
texts.fix: Check.

faults.detectedBy: AI (31nn)–(36nn), (30), (37) with value 0

texts.what: Other typed fields
texts.why: The AI's definition in section 3.
texts.fix: Per message.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linters: country (ISO 3166), currency (ISO 4217), IBAN, coupon structure, latitude and longitude, piece of total

texts.what: A required companion AI is missing
texts.where: The AI that lacks its companion
texts.why: Mandatory association of element strings (4.13.2): e.g. (17) or (10) need (01) or (02); (02) needs (00) and (37).
texts.fix: Add the companion; in a group reading, the companion may be in another symbol (C9).

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Required AIs for AI (x) are not satisfied (on by default)

texts.what: Two AIs that may not appear together
texts.why: Invalid pairs of element strings (4.13.1): e.g. (01) with (02); (420) with (421).
texts.fix: Remove one.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: It is invalid to pair AI (x) with AI (y)

texts.what: Serial missing where the scheme needs it
texts.why: The AI's own rule.
texts.fix: Add the serial.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Serial component must be present…

texts.what: A symbol the context's table does not list
texts.why: Symbol specification tables (5.12.3) and the application standards of section 2.1 with the summary in 2.7.
texts.fix: The studio lists the symbols the table allows for this data (guidance()), recommended first.

faults.detectedBy: specificationsFor(table, symbol) empty for the reading context. Typical: EAN/UPC or ITF-14 on a logistic unit (table 5), EAN/UPC as a direct part mark (table 7), ITF-14 at a retail till (table 1), a QR Code on a regulated healthcare item (tables 6, 8, 10 name Data Matrix)

texts.what: EAN/UPC asked to carry more than a GTIN
texts.why: EAN/UPC carries 13 digits (table 5-2).
texts.fix: Add a 2D symbol or GS1 DataBar Expanded.

faults.detectedBy: Not a reading fault: shown when the user says attributes were expected

texts.what: A 2D symbol alone at a retail point of sale
texts.why: During the migration a 2D symbol SHALL be used in addition to EAN/UPC or GS1 DataBar (4.15.4 rule 1).
texts.fix: Scan the linear symbol too (group reading), or add one.

faults.detectedBy: Context retail, one reading, 2D

texts.what: Add-on symbol
texts.why: Valid for periodicals and books; many tills ignore it.
texts.fix: None.

references: The Check Studio project, section 3.6 (the reading context)

texts.what: Context not given
texts.why: Groups F and H need it.
texts.fix: Choose the context.

faults.detectedBy: The user chose "I do not know"

texts.what: A web address with no GS1 key
texts.why: An ordinary link: nothing a till or a resolver can identify.
texts.fix: Not a fault if no GS1 code was intended; else rebuild as https://example.com/01/{gtin}.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: No GS1 DL keys found in path info

texts.what: Qualifiers in the wrong order, or not belonging to the key
texts.why: The path is the key, then its qualifiers in the fixed order (for a GTIN: 22, 10, 21). inUriOrder() gives it.
texts.fix: The studio shows the re-ordered URI.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: The AIs in the path are not a valid key-qualifier sequence for the key

texts.what: An attribute in the path, or a qualifier in the query
texts.why: Attributes (dates, weights) go in the query string.
texts.fix: Move it.

faults.detectedBy: Engine, as G2; own rule for the query

texts.what: Unknown AI in the query
texts.why: Numeric keys in the query are AIs and must exist; other parameters are allowed and ignored.
texts.fix: Correct the AI or rename the parameter.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Unknown AI (x) in query parameters

texts.what: An AI a URI cannot carry
texts.why: The standard's list of data attributes.
texts.fix: Remove it.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: AI (x) is not a valid DL URI data attribute

texts.what: Bad percent-encoding, or a reserved character left raw
texts.why: A lot AB/12 must be AB%2F12; raw, the URI ends at the slash.
texts.fix: percentEncode(); the corrected URI is shown.

faults.detectedBy: Engine linter invalid percent hex-encoding; own rule: /, ?, #, %, & inside a value cut the URI short

texts.what: Not canonical, though valid
texts.why: Valid on a custom domain. The canonical form on id.gs1.org is shown beside it as what the URI means.
texts.fix: None needed.

faults.detectedBy: Compared with digitalLinkUri of the parse: GTIN not 14 digits, extra path before the key, upper-case host, trailing slash, fragment

texts.what: http:// instead of https://; a non-web scheme
texts.why: Browsers and phones increasingly refuse plain HTTP; NFC requires https (4.15.3).
texts.fix: Use https://.

faults.detectedBy: Engine: Scheme must be http:// or https://; own rule for http

texts.what: Short names in the path (/gtin/ for /01/)
texts.why: Removed from the current standard; many parsers reject them (to be confirmed against the engine).
texts.fix: Use the numeric AI.

faults.detectedBy: Own rule

texts.what: A compressed Digital Link URI
texts.why: Valid, but few scanners decode it. Decoding it is open question Q8.
texts.fix: Prefer the uncompressed form.

faults.detectedBy: Own rule: a single opaque path segment of the compression alphabet

texts.what: The key's check digit, dates and values inside the URI
texts.why: Same rules; the URI is another syntax for the same data (1.4.4).
texts.fix: As there.

faults.detectedBy: Groups C, D, E on the URI's elements

faults.severityNote: Warning; Not assessed without a scale

texts.what: X-dimension outside the context's range
texts.where: Outline on the picture; value with its tolerance
texts.why: Symbol specification tables (5.12.3).
texts.fix: Re-make at the target X; the generator link carries the context.

faults.detectedBy: The symbol's corners (ZXing position), its module count, and a scale the user gives: the symbol's printed width in mm, or a reference of known size in the picture. Compared with specificationFor(table, symbol).x

texts.what: Quiet zone too small
texts.why: Readers need the quiet zone (5.2.3.4 for EAN/UPC; the tables).
texts.fix: Clear the area.

faults.detectedBy: Light margin around the outline, in modules, against the table's quiet zone

texts.what: Bars truncated
texts.why: EAN/UPC is read omnidirectionally only at full height (5.12.2.2).
texts.fix: Restore the height.

faults.detectedBy: Height to width ratio against minimumBarHeight()

texts.what: Light on dark, or mirrored
texts.why: Many scanners do not read reversed or mirrored symbols; expected only in direct part marking.
texts.fix: Print dark on light, unmirrored.

faults.detectedBy: ZXing isInverted, isMirrored

texts.what: Human readable text does not match the data
texts.why: HRI rules (4.14); even a verifier does not check this (5.12.5.1).
texts.fix: Correct the text.

faults.detectedBy: Not automated: the report has a manual tick "the text under the symbol matches" with the expected HRI printed beside it

faults.severityNote: Note (non-GS1 tag) or Error (a GS1 header, malformed)

texts.what: Not an EPC, or an unknown header
texts.why: EPC Tag Data Standard 2.3, the header table.
texts.fix: Check the tag was encoded with a GS1 scheme.

faults.detectedBy: decodeEpc() and decodeEpcPlus() return null

texts.what: EPC fields inconsistent
texts.why: TDS 2.3 coding tables.
texts.fix: Re-encode; the RFID Studio (6.12) makes it.

faults.detectedBy: Partition against the company prefix length (gcpLengthOf()), filter value, check digit of the key rebuilt from the EPC

texts.what: NFC: the URI is not the first record, not a URI record, or not https
texts.why: The GS1 Digital Link URI SHALL be the first record, a Well-Known Type URI record, with https:// or https://www. (4.15.3).
texts.fix: Re-write the tag (NfcWriter).

faults.detectedBy: The NDEF records of the reading

texts.what: NFC: the URI itself
texts.why: As G.
texts.fix: As G.

faults.detectedBy: Group G

texts.what: Different GTINs (or other keys) on one item
texts.why: All carriers used for the same application on an entity SHALL encode the same GS1 identifier (4.15.1 rule 2; rule 8 for a supplemental carrier beside EAN/UPC or ITF-14).
texts.fix: Correct the odd one out. If they are different packaging levels, they are different items: split the group.

faults.detectedBy: The key row of the matrix

texts.what: Same attribute, different values (batch, expiry, serial, weight)
texts.why: Attribute values in several carriers SHALL be the same (4.15.1 rule 3).
texts.fix: One source of data for all symbols of a print run.

faults.detectedBy: Attribute rows

texts.what: Attributes in one symbol, their GTIN only in another
texts.why: Accepted for some healthcare scenarios (4.15.5, table 4-6), but GS1-128 SHOULD carry the GTIN with its attributes in one symbol (4.15.1 rule 9; 4.15.5 rule 3), and with GS1 DataBar or 2D they SHALL be in one symbol (4.15.4 note).
texts.fix: Concatenate key and attributes in one symbol.

faults.detectedBy: A reading with C9 or E1 whose companion carries the key

texts.what: Retail pack with a 2D symbol and no EAN/UPC or GS1 DataBar
texts.why: 4.15.4 rule 1. Resolves F3 when the linear symbol is in the group.
texts.fix: Add the linear symbol, or scan it.

faults.detectedBy: Group of kind consumer pack, context retail, no linear reading

faults.severityNote: Warning; Not assessed without a scale

texts.what: The 2D symbol is far from the linear one
texts.why: For retail POS the whole 2D symbol SHOULD lie within a 50 mm radius of the centre of the linear symbol, or the till may not relate them (6.3.3.1). An estimate, as group H.
texts.fix: Move the 2D symbol; or, if it serves another application, keep it away on purpose (4.15.1 rule 6).

faults.detectedBy: One picture with a scale: distance from the centre of the linear symbol to the farthest edge of the 2D symbol and its quiet zone, against 50 mm

texts.what: A supplemental 2D symbol missing data of the GS1-128
texts.why: In general distribution the GS1-128's element strings SHALL at a minimum be in the supplemental 2D symbol (4.15.1 rule 10).
texts.fix: Add them.

faults.detectedBy: Case or logistic label group: element strings in the GS1-128 absent from the 2D symbol

texts.what: EPC and barcode disagree
texts.why: With a GTIN barcode the tag SHALL be an SGTIN; if the barcode has AI (21) it SHALL be the same serial, no character changed, no leading zero added or removed (4.15.2 a). The same for ITIP, GRAI, GLN with extension, GDTI (4.15.2 b to e). The studio also says when the barcode's serial cannot fit the tag's scheme (SGTIN-96 holds digits without leading zeros only).
texts.fix: Re-encode the tag (SGTIN-198 or SGTIN+ for such serials), or change the serial policy.

faults.detectedBy: Key and serial rows, EPC column

texts.what: NFC tag and 2D symbol disagree
texts.why: The NFC tag SHALL carry the same hostname and identifier values as the 2D symbol, the same extra data elements, and the same protocol (4.15.3).
texts.fix: Re-write the tag with the symbol's URI.

faults.detectedBy: URI rows: host, scheme, key, each data element

texts.what: A logistic label that contradicts itself
texts.why: One logistic unit, one SSCC (2.2; label design 6.6); mandatory associations hold across the label's symbols (4.13.2).
texts.fix: Correct the label; the Label Studio's GS1 Logistic Label makes it.

faults.detectedBy: Logistic label group: more than one SSCC, or the same AI with different values across its GS1-128 symbols; (02) without (37) or without the SSCC anywhere on the label

texts.what: A non-GS1 symbol on the pack
texts.why: A symbol for production control SHOULD be as obscure as possible or obstructed (4.15.1 rule 7). Scanners must tell it apart by symbology identifier (rule 1).
texts.fix: Hide it or move it.

faults.detectedBy: A8 inside a group
